headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 6, 2026**
article:
The San Francisco Giants made a statement with an 18-3 win over the Chicago Cubs, led by Matt Chapman's two home runs and eight RBIs. Robbie Ray earned the win with 5.0 innings of scoreless relief. In other action, the Boston Red Sox took down the New York Yankees 5-3, with Sonny Gray earning the win and Willson Contreras leading the Red Sox offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Colorado Rockies right-hander Tanner Gordon, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right hip impingement. The San Diego Padres have also been hit with injuries, with Jeremiah Estrada going on the 15-day injured list for right knee inflammation and Ramón Laureano being transferred to the 60-day injured list. Other teams have also suffered injuries, including the Milwaukee Brewers, St. Louis Cardinals, Boston Red Sox, New York Yankees, and Kansas City Royals.

The Boston Red Sox made a significant addition to their pitching staff with the acquisition of left-hander Joe La Sorsa in a trade with the Pittsburgh Pirates. Other trades and roster movements include the Cincinnati Reds trading RHP Kyle Nicolas to the Baltimore Orioles for cash, the Los Angeles Angels trading C Austin Wynns to the Atlanta Braves for cash, and the Minnesota Twins trading RHP Simeon Woods Richardson to the Toronto Blue Jays for cash.

top_news.title: **Giants Rout Cubs 18-3 in Dominant Performance**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants secured a convincing 18-3 victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Matt Chapman leading the charge at the plate. Chapman's impressive outing included two home runs and eight RBIs, while Robbie Ray earned the win with 5.0 innings of scoreless relief.

top_news.title: **Mariners Fall to Tigers in 7-3 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners suffered a 7-3 defeat at the hands of the Detroit Tigers, with Framber Valdez earning the win after 5.0 innings of work.

top_news.title: **Phillies Take Down White Sox in Thrilling 8-6 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies won the game 8-6, outscoring the Chicago White Sox. Randal Grichuk led the White Sox with 2 hits and 2 home runs.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Take Down Yankees 5-3**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox secured a 5-3 victory over the New York Yankees, with Sonny Gray earning the win. Willson Contreras led the Red Sox offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rockies RHP Tanner Gordon Lands on 15-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Colorado Rockies right-hander Tanner Gordon has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right hip impingement, effective retroactive to June 2, 2026.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Acquire Left-Handed Pitcher in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox have bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of left-hander Joe La Sorsa, acquired in a trade with the Pittsburgh Pirates.
